_comment: klt lvs request for layout/analog/se_receiver_dp (issue #221), engine klayout-runset:
the PDK's own sky130.lvs runset, so the 5V devices and the xhigh_po resistor are recognised.
Paths are repo-relative and `$PDK_ROOT` is the open_pdks tree run_checks.py resolved and
verified against sim/pdk-pins.json; run_checks.py writes an absolute-path copy to a scratch
directory (klt resolves request paths against the request file) and runs that.
convert_subckts=true  the reference is an xschem export of `X<name> ... <model> L= W=` lines;
without it the runset reads them as calls to an undefined subcircuit
and the reference has no devices (klayout-tools#3989).
scale=true            the reference writes L/W in micrometres with no unit suffix, which the
SPICE reader stores as metres; the runset scales the layout side by
thr=2                 runset thread count; this host is shared and the repo's rule is to stay
